summary: Update 9:20 am MYT: Philadelphia leads Detroit 48-31 late in the 2nd quarter (ESPN gives the 76ers about 92%), and Boston started fast without Tatum. Utah-New Orleans has now tipped off, and I found no live price, so the earlier Utah idea is withdrawn - no picks right now. Later games (Denver, Phoenix, San Antonio, Sacramento, Clippers, 10:00-11:30 am MYT) have no new injury news yet; watch for lineups about 30 minutes before each tip.

games.note: Live since ~8:00 am MYT; I could not find a live score this check, so the pre-game estimate is kept. Jalen Johnson OUT for Atlanta; pre-game Wizards +120 (2.20).
76ers lead 48-31 with 5:17 left in the 2nd quarter (ESPN). Live DraftKings: Pistons +310 (4.10) - still no value given a 17-point deficit; Detroit is without Duren and Joe.
Live since 8:30 am MYT, no live score found. Pre-game Hornets -158, Nets +133; Brooklyn without Demin.
Celtics led 19-8 midway through the 1st quarter without Tatum (rest) and Devin Carter; Pritchard is playing. Paul George back in the lineup.
Live since 8:30 am MYT; a live blog headline showed the Knicks well ahead (43-21), not confirmed. Hart OUT for NY, Claxton OUT for Chicago.
Tipped ~9:00 am MYT with Trey Murphy III OUT and Missi out for New Orleans; Utah without Jaren Jackson Jr. and Nurkic. No live price found, so no pick.
Tipped ~9:00 am MYT. Zubac is starting for Indiana (was questionable); Haliburton and McConnell out. Pre-game Grizzlies about -230.
Tipped ~9:00 am MYT. OKC without Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace; Cleveland missing Tyson, Watson and others. Pre-game Thunder about -165.
Tips 9:30 am MYT. Rockets about -285. Minnesota without Edwards, DiVincenzo and Terrence Shannon Jr.; Houston without Capela and Adams.
Nuggets about -190. Toronto without Kawhi Leonard; Jakob Poeltl questionable.
Portland about -150 even with Ja Morant out. Suns' Rasheer Fleming out (ankle), Jordan Goodwin questionable.
Spurs about -600. Dallas without Lively, Christie and now Santi Aldama (ruled out).
Lakers about -600. Sacramento without Keegan Murray and now Daeqwon Plowden (illness).
Heat about -215 with Giannis Antetokounmpo probable. Clippers without Ingram and Beal; Isaiah Jackson questionable.
